name: org_graph_move_unit
description: Move a unit in the Org Graph beneath another live unit at a higher level, or to the top when parent_id is omitted, from effective_on (today by default). Only a unit Espalia holds can be moved here. Moving a unit changes who inherits its ownership, so the caller needs rights on the unit and where it lands.

plan_id.description: the plan whose change this applies. Refused unless you may apply that plan's changes

plan_change_id.description: the plan change this applies; needs plan_id

cause_id.description: groups this with the plan's other changes, to change back together; needs plan_id
